title: Labels Are Not Endpoints: Treatment Leakage and Construct Validity in MCP Agent Security Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Security evaluations of tool-using agents often equate stored labels with behavioral facts. We audit a preserved campaign by tracing 10,200 execution rows to 180 model-bound requests, 45 semantic requests, and 15 observable stimuli. Two schema treatments were delivered, but the planned external payload-family corpus was not. The historical grader exhibited direct treatment leakage: treatment metadata gated the ATTACK_SUCCESS class, so fixed behavior could change class under treatment relabeling. A treatment-blind reconstruction corrects 58 historical ATTACK_SUCCESS or HIJACK_ATTEMPT labels to authorized benign completions while preserving three verified protected-data transfers and one separate unauthorized-forwarding case. The locked v2 census contains exactly zero ATTACK_SUCCESS records, while the forwarding case remains a HIJACK_ATTEMPT at a semantic boundary concerning objective completion. translated_title: 标签不是终点：MCP代理安全评估中的处理泄漏与构念效度
translated_abstract: 对使用工具的代理进行安全评估时，常将存储的标签等同于行为事实。我们通过追踪10,200条执行记录至180个模型绑定请求、45个语义请求和15个可观察刺激，审计了一项保留的活动。虽然交付了两种模式处理，但计划中的外部载荷族语料库并未交付。历史评分器表现出直接的处理泄漏：处理元数据门控了ATTACK_SUCCESS类别，因此固定行为在处理重新标记下可能改变类别。一种处理盲重建纠正了58个历史ATTACK_SUCCESS或HIJACK_ATTEMPT标签为授权的良性完成，同时保留了三个已验证的受保护数据传输和一个独立的未授权转发案例。锁定的v2普查中恰好包含零条ATTACK_SUCCESS记录，而转发案例在关于目标完成的语义边界上仍为HIJACK_ATTEMPT。一项双审阅者盲法一致性审查...
tldr: 该论文发现MCP代理安全评估中标签存在处理泄漏问题，导致历史标签与真实行为不符，并提出盲重建方法纠正了58个错误标签，强调了标签作为构念效度而非行为终点的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals treatment leakage in MCP agent security evaluation where labels misrepresent actual behavior, and proposes a treatment-blind reconstruction correcting 58 historical labels, emphasizing that labels are not endpoints but require construct validity.
